text: SpaceX shares declined following the company's first public earnings release, despite reported revenue and earnings exceeding expectations. Reported AI-related capital expenditures of $18.4 billion became the primary disclosed balance-sheet change alongside continued investment in AI computing infrastructure.

meta.note: This entry captures the market validation event following the prior earnings disclosure rather than the earnings release itself.

text: Disney reported quarterly financial results and announced that its consumer products business will move from the Experiences segment to the Entertainment unit beginning in fiscal 2027. The company also increased its fiscal 2026 share repurchase target following the sale of its A+E Global Media stake.

meta.note: The organizational realignment is the primary structural change; earnings provide supporting operational context.

text: Eli Lilly reported second-quarter revenue of $22.97 billion and raised its full-year revenue outlook to $85-87 billion. Mounjaro and Zepbound remained the company's dominant revenue contributors, while Foundayo generated initial commercial sales. The company also reported acquisition-related charges associated with transactions completed during the quarter.

meta.note: The earnings release includes prior announced acquisitions; the dominant atomic event is financial validation of the existing portfolio.

text: ADP reported 44,000 private-sector jobs added in July. Services added 47,000 jobs while goods-producing industries declined by 3,000. Education and health services accounted for 36,000 new jobs. Annual pay growth remained 4.4% for job stayers and 7.0% for job changers.

meta.note: This entry reflects the ADP private employment release rather than the official government payroll report.
